description: This Java class creates BSON filter objects for querying a database, specifically for criteria-based searches with authorization and visibility restrictions.

classes.name: CreateBsonVisitor
classes.description: Creates BSON objects for querying criteria with optional authorization restrictions, implementing the CriteriaVisitor interface.

methods.name: CreateBsonVisitor
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes the visitor with optional authorization subject IDs.

methods.name: sudoApply
methods.description: Creates a BSON query without visibility restrictions, ideal for administrative or internal use.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a BSON query for the given criteria, applying visibility restrictions based on provided authorization subject IDs.

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for ExistsFieldExpression.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a field with a predicate.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Returns an empty BSON document, representing a match-all query.

methods.name: visitNor
methods.description: Creates a BSON NOR filter from a list of BSON filters.

methods.name: visitOr
methods.description: Creates a BSON OR filter from a list of BSON filters.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Creates a BSON AND filter from a list of BSON filters.
